640	אכסניות אוספת בבתי מלון נדבות והולכת ומפרנסת את אותו	She would go to the guesthouses, to the inns, collecting charity, and she would support that very	Ela ia às hospedarias, às pousadas, recolhendo donativos, e sustentava aquele mesmo
641	רשע את אותו רופא רשע, כשהיא שמעה שהבעל שם טוב מגיע לעיר,	wicked man, that wicked doctor. When she heard that the Baal Shem Tov was coming to the city,	perverso, aquele médico perverso. Quando ela soube que o Baal Shem Tov estava chegando à cidade,
642	הוא ראה ברוח הקודש שיש פה איזו אחת גדולה, הוא נסע לעותר, כשהיא שמעה שהבעל שם טוב הגיע,	he saw with divine inspiration that there was a great woman here. When she heard that the Baal Shem Tov had arrived,	ele viu com inspiração divina que havia ali uma mulher grande. Quando ela soube que o Baal Shem Tov tinha chegado,
643	הלכה לה בעל שם טוב לבקש בן דבר.	she went to the Baal Shem Tov to ask for something.	ela foi até o Baal Shem Tov para pedir algo.
644	למה?	Why?	Para quê?
645	בשביל אותו רופא מושחת שחולה, צריך תרופות, צריך זה, צריך ההוא.	For that corrupt doctor who was ill, who needed medicines, needed this, needed that.	Para aquele médico corrupto que estava doente, que precisava de remédios, disto, daquilo.
646	בעל שם טוב שואל אותה, למי את אוספת?	The Baal Shem Tov asks her, "For whom are you collecting?"	O Baal Shem Tov lhe pergunta: "Para quem você está recolhendo?"
647	אמרה, יש אחת חולה.	She said, "There is someone who is sick."	Ela disse: "Há alguém doente."
648	נתן לה שישה פרוטות.	He gave her six pennies.	Ele lhe deu seis moedas.
649	אמרה, מה פתאום, דבר כזה אני לא לוקחת.	She said, "Not at all, I don't take that much."	Ela disse: "De jeito nenhum, tanto assim eu não aceito."
650	הוסיף לה עוד, לא מה פתאום, עוד לא, מה יש פה חולה ממש מסוכל,	He added more for her. "No, not at all, no more. What is this, a truly gravely ill person?"	Ele acrescentou mais. "Não, de jeito nenhum, mais não. O que é isso, um doente realmente em perigo?"
651	מה הסיפור?	What is the story?	Qual é a história?
652	סיפרה לו, יש כאן בן אדם וזה אומרת, אבל כולם אומרים שהוא רשע מרושע וזה וכו',	She told him, "There is a man here," and she added, "but everyone says he is a vile, wicked man, and so on."	Ela lhe contou: "Há aqui um homem", e disse: "mas todos dizem que ele é um perverso, malvado, e assim por diante."
653	היא אומרת לה בעל שם טוב, נכון, כולם אומרים, וגם אני יודעת, הוא רשע מרושע אבל אל	She says to the Baal Shem Tov, "True, everyone says it, and I also know, he is a vile, wicked man, but do not	Ela diz ao Baal Shem Tov: "É verdade, todos dizem, e eu também sei, ele é um perverso, malvado, mas não"
654	תכעסו עליו, הוא לא יודע, הוא לא יודע, אם הוא היה יודע הוא לא היה עושה את מה שהוא עשה	be angry at him. He doesn't know, he doesn't know. If he knew, he would not have done what he did."	"fiquem com raiva dele. Ele não sabe, ele não sabe. Se soubesse, não teria feito o que fez."
655	אמר הבעל שם טוב הקדוש, עכשיו אני מבין למה בשמיים אמרו שזאת מקוטלגת	The holy Baal Shem Tov said, "Now I understand why in Heaven they said that this woman is ranked	O santo Baal Shem Tov disse: "Agora entendo por que no Céu disseram que esta mulher está classificada"
656	בשורה הראשונה עם הצדקניות.	in the first row with the righteous women."	"na primeira fila, com as justas."
657	הוא לא יודע!	He doesn't know!	Ele não sabe!
658	כך מובא בספר ליקוטים יקרים.	So it is brought in the book Likutim Yekarim.	Assim consta no livro Likutim Yekarim.
659	הוא לא יודע.	He doesn't know.	Ele não sabe.
660	ונסלח לכל עם בשגגיו.	"And it shall be forgiven to the whole people, for it was done in error."	"E será perdoado a todo o povo, pois foi por engano."
661	זה רצון ה'.	This is the will of HaShem.	Esta é a vontade de HaShem.
662	אתה אל תוריד יהודי, אל תזרוק אבן אחרי נופל.	Do not bring a Jew down; do not throw a stone at one who has fallen.	Não rebaixe um judeu; não atire uma pedra em quem já caiu.
663	ותדרדר אותו יותר למטה.	And do not push him down even lower.	E não o empurre ainda mais para baixo.
664	לא יודע, עם ישראל תמימים, לא יודעים.	He doesn't know. The people of Israel are innocent; they don't know.	Ele não sabe. O povo de Israel é inocente; eles não sabem.
665	מסופר על רבי חיים מצאנץ, שפעם	It is told of Rabbi Chaim of Tzanz that once	Conta-se sobre Rabi Chaim de Tzanz que uma vez
666	נכנס אצל הרב, ראה את הרבנית שואלת על כנף אווז,	he went in to see the Rav and saw the Rebbetzin asking about a goose wing.	entrou onde estava o Rav e viu a rabanit perguntando sobre uma asa de ganso.
667	מה השאלה של אותה אישה, שבכלל לא הייתה בעניינים.	What was the question of that woman, who was not at all well-versed in these matters?	Qual era a pergunta dessa mulher, que não entendia nada do assunto?
668	היא באה לשאול מהרב שאלה, מה השאלה?	She came to ask the Rav a question. What was the question?	Ela veio fazer uma pergunta ao Rav. Qual era a pergunta?
669	כנף אווז ששמה אותו על ספסל חלבי.	A goose wing that she placed on a dairy bench.	Uma asa de ganso que ela pôs sobre um banco de laticínios.
670	האם הכנף אווז הזה הפך להיות בשרי?	Did this goose wing become meat?	Essa asa de ganso passou a ser de carne?
671	לא.	No.	Não.
672	הפך להיות חלבי או לא חלבי?	Did the bench become dairy, or not dairy?	O banco passou a ser de laticínios ou não?
673	ספסל שיאכלו עליו בשור...	A bench on which one eats meat...	Um banco em que se come carne...
674	עליו, אין לכו עליו כנף אווז קר.	...on it. There is nothing there; it is a cold goose wing.	...sobre ele. Não há nada ali; é uma asa de ganso fria.
675	אין בזה כלום.	There is nothing to it.	Não há nada nisso.
676	פשוט.	Simple.	Simples.
677	אבל היא בתמימות שלה, לא יודעת מה לשאול.	But in her innocence, she doesn't know what to ask.	Mas, na sua inocência, ela não sabe o que perguntar.
678	כמו מעשיות בבעלי תשובה על ימין ועל שמאל ששואלים שאלות של חלם.	Like the stories about baalei teshuvah, left and right, who ask foolish questions.	Como as histórias de baalei teshuvá, por toda parte, que fazem perguntas bobas.
679	לא יודעים.	They don't know.	Eles não sabem.
